intro: Sponsorship is vital to the success and sustainability of our club, helping us to provide opportunities for players to train, compete and develop in a safe and supportive environment. Your support contributes to the general running of the club, including equipment for training and matches, safeguarding and first-aid training for volunteers as required by England Netball, and essential coaching and venue fees.

howText: Pick the level you'd like to sponsor at and send us a quick enquiry. You can upload your logo with it, or send it to us later.
